description: Encode bounded caller-supplied UTF-8 text as standard or URL-safe Base64, or decode canonical Base64 back to valid UTF-8 text. Forest performs the transform locally with no network request and rejects invalid encodings, non-UTF-8 decoded bytes, and outputs beyond the 100 KiB byte bound. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call.
